opportunities.name: Plan a city weekend trip and email the itinerary
opportunities.description: For a given destination city, dates and party size: look up the city on Wikipedia, check the weather on timeanddate, pick a hotel on Booking.com, find activities on Viator, find a dinner table on OpenTable, save a summary in Notes, and email the plan to a friend.
opportunities.site: wikipedia.org, timeanddate.com, booking.com, viator.com, opentable.com, Notes app, webmail compose
steps: On Wikipedia, search for {city} and open the article to get key facts such as population
On timeanddate.com, search for {city} and open the weather page to note the current temperature
On Booking.com, enter {city} as the destination, set check-in {start_date} and check-out {end_date}, set adults to {adults}, then search
Open the chosen hotel's page (Info & prices) and note its name and price
On Viator, search '{activity_1} {city}' and open the top result; repeat for '{activity_2} {city}'
On OpenTable, set date {dinner_date}, time and party size, search '{city} {cuisine}', and pick a restaurant and a time slot (e.g. 18:30)
In Notes, add the note '{city} {dates}: pop X, temp, hotel, activities, dinner {restaurant} {time}'
In a new email, set To={friend_email}, Subject='{city} weekend {start}-{end}', and Body='Hi {name}, plan: hotel ..., activities ..., dinner at ... on {date}'
Send the email or discard the draft
